title: Calder Bay dispatch team charter
brief: I'm Dilys Penhallow, team lead of the Calder Bay Coast Dispatch Centre, and I want a team charter that all 14 of us can read and sign at the start of our new rota on 2026-11-02. It will be printed and pinned in the break room, so it needs to read well on paper, mostly as headings and plain paragraphs. Sections: "Why we exist": we answer emergency calls from the coast between Harrow Point and Selden Sands, and for the person on the line we are the first thing that goes right. "How we work": 12-hour shifts, a 15-minute handover with the next shift, calls answered within 10 seconds 95 percent of the time, and no one working more than 4 night shifts in a row. "How we decide": the shift supervisor decides in the moment, the team decides rules at the monthly meeting on the first Tuesday, and anyone may stop a handover to ask a question. "What we promise each other": a short list of four promises, we say when we are struggling, we cover each other's breaks, we debrief after every serious call within 24 hours, and we never blame a person for a system problem. Close with a highlighted line: nobody takes a hard call alone. Say that the charter is reviewed on 2027-03-01.

visible: nobody takes a hard call alone

edit.request: Change the answer target from 10 seconds to 8 seconds and the review date to 2027-04-01, and add a fifth promise: "we always eat a proper meal on shift".
expect_visible: we always eat a proper meal on shift
